outcome: Deterministic MCP/REST probes grade transport and application failures as failures, support structural response contracts, keep bounded redacted response evidence with hashes, and refuse to overwrite prior runs, so a green probe means what it says.
acceptance_criteria: A tools/call reply with a JSON-RPC error, a mismatched id, isError true, or empty data fails the mcp_payload layer; the 0.1.0 'returns something' pass is no longer possible for those

A 2xx application-error envelope (ok:false) fails unless a json_any_of branch explicitly matches a not_found/404 typed absence with reason and nonempty message; auth, entitlement, rate-limit and 5xx envelopes cannot use a success branch

json_any_of contracts (JSON Pointer path, type, nonempty, equals; branches = alternatives, predicates = conjunction) are validated before any request and graded against structuredContent.data or JSON text content; REST contracts against the JSON body
Each layer records assertion_strength in {structured, content, negative_only, liveness}; results.py ingest renders a coverage table and marks pre-0.2.0 reports unknown_legacy

Each layer keeps a response receipt: sha256 of the canonical original, up to 16384 chars of sanitized text, truncated/redacted flags; known run credentials, secret-named keys, bearer/GitHub/JWT-shaped strings are redacted best-effort

The run record carries plan/profile sha256, the plan's declared bank hash, harness source hashes, local repo revisions and observed serverInfo; an existing output path or an empty executable selection is refused before any request
demandlib validates json_any_of in payload and rest sections; probe_checks is imported lazily inside validate_bank, not at module scope
All 78 tests pass against local HTTP fixtures with no network (ledger run f65df2615777 at 182cc9e)
changed_behavior: probe.py run: decodes JSON-RPC replies strictly (probe_checks.decode_rpc), adds transport and application-error checks ahead of grade(), evaluates json_any_of, labels layer strength, writes receipts, refuses existing output and empty selection, records hashes/revisions/serverInfo; opens output with 'x'. probe.py plan: exports json_any_of. demandlib.validate_bank: validates json_any_of (lazy import). results.collect_probe/cmd_ingest: probe_strengths and coverage table. Entry points: probe.py plan|run, results.py ingest, bank.py validate.
